metadata.canonicalQuery:
fetch spans, from:"2026-09-19T08:26:09.410Z", to:"2026-09-19T08:26:13.634Z"
| filter service.namespace == "easytrade-otel-lab" AND service.name == "credit-card-order-service"
| filter span.kind == "server"
| filter http.response.status_code >= 500 AND http.response.status_code <= 599
| summarize by:{service.name, http.route}, {server_spans = countDistinct(span.id), traces = countDistinct(trace.id), min_status = min(http.response.status_code), max_status = max(http.response.status_code), first = min(start_time), last = max(start_time)}
